<style>
/* ================================
   Star rating summary: centered + separators + yellow stars
   ================================ */

/* Center the whole block on the page */
.defaqto-star-summary {
  border: none:
  border-radius: 8px;
  padding: 12px 14px;
  margin: 0 auto 12px auto;   /* centers the block */
  background: #fff;
  max-width: 980px;           /* keep it tidy on wide screens */
  text-align: center;         /* center inner content */
}

/* The row of product star ratings, centered */
.defaqto-star-grid {
  display: inline-flex;       /* inline-flex so it can be centered via text-align */
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  gap: 0;                     /* separators handle spacing */
  flex-wrap: wrap;            /* wraps nicely on mobile */
}

/* Each product block */
.defaqto-star-item {
  padding: 0 16px;
  min-width: 220px;
}

/* Vertical line between items (not after the last one) */
.defaqto-star-item:not(:last-child) {
  border-right: 1px solid #e5e7eb;
}

/* Company name: NOT bold + smaller */
.defaqto-star-name {
  font-weight: 500;
  font-size: 13px;
  margin-bottom: 6px;
  color: #333;
}

/* ================================
   Star rating component (table + star summary)
   ================================ */

.defaqto-compare .star-rating,
.star-rating {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  white-space: nowrap;
  line-height: 1;
  font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont,
               "Segoe UI", Roboto, Arial, sans-serif;
}

/* Individual stars (bigger) */
.defaqto-compare .star-rating__star,
.star-rating__star {
  font-size: 1.7em;             /* increase star size */
  margin-right: 1px;          /* small gap between stars */
  line-height: 1;
  color: #FFC107 !important;  /* yellow for both filled + empty */
}

/* Empty stars stay yellow but dim */
.defaqto-compare .star-rating__star.is-empty,
.star-rating__star.is-empty {
  opacity: 0.35;
}

/* Number after the stars: (5), (2), etc. */
.defaqto-compare .star-rating__number,
.star-rating__number {
  margin-left: 8px;
  font-size: 1em;
  color: #333;
}

/* Mobile: if it wraps, remove vertical separators and add spacing */
@media (max-width: 640px) {
  .defaqto-star-item {
    min-width: auto;
    padding: 10px 12px;
  }
  .defaqto-star-item:not(:last-child) {
    border-right: none;
    border-bottom: 1px solid #e5e7eb;
  }
}
</style>

<script>
// Defaqto help tooltip behaviour (click to open, click "close" to hide)
(function () {
  if (window.__defaqtoHelpHandlersBound) return;
  window.__defaqtoHelpHandlersBound = true;

  // Open / toggle panel on icon click
  jQuery(document).on("click", ".question-help-trigger", function (e) {
    e.preventDefault();

    var $btn   = jQuery(this);
    var $cell  = $btn.closest("th.question");
    var $panel = $cell.find(".question-help-panel").first();

    // Close any other open panels
    jQuery(".question-help-panel").not($panel).attr("hidden", true);
    jQuery(".question-help-trigger[aria-expanded='true']").attr("aria-expanded", "false");

    var isHidden = $panel.is("[hidden]");

    if (isHidden) {
      $panel.removeAttr("hidden");
      $btn.attr("aria-expanded", "true");
    } else {
      $panel.attr("hidden", true);
      $btn.attr("aria-expanded", "false");
    }
  });

  // Close button inside panel
  jQuery(document).on("click", ".question-help-close", function (e) {
    e.preventDefault();
    var $panel = jQuery(this).closest(".question-help-panel");
    var $btn   = $panel.closest("th.question").find(".question-help-trigger").first();
    $panel.attr("hidden", true);
    $btn.attr("aria-expanded", "false");
  });
})();
</script>

<style>
/* Ensure the icon + label sit on the same line */
.defaqto-compare th.question {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 6px; /* nice spacing */
  position: relative;
  overflow: visible; /* allow panel to extend outside cell */
  vertical-align: top;
}

/* Make inner icon + text group inline-flex so they stay together */
.question-label,
.question-help-trigger {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
}

/* Prevent the icon from forcing a line break */
.question-help-trigger {
  flex-shrink: 0; /* icon will never wrap alone */
  background: none;
  border: none;
  padding: 0;
  margin-right: 4px;  /* space before text */
  cursor: pointer;
}

/* Allow long question text to wrap normally */
.question-label {
  white-space: normal;
}

.defaqto-compare th.question .question-label {
  display: inline-block;
  margin-left: 4px;   /* space after icon */
}

/* Small blue circular icon */
.question-help-icon {
  display: inline-block;

  height: 16px;
  line-height: 14px;
  text-align: center;
  border-radius: 50%;

  color: #29508c;
  font-size: 11px;
  font-weight: bold;
  font-family: Arial, sans-serif;
  background-color: #ffffff;
}

/* Help panel box */

  top: 100%;
  right: 0;
  margin-top: 4px;
  max-width: 380px;
  background-color: #ffffff;
  border: 1px solid #29508c;
  box-shadow: 0 2px 6px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.2);
  padding: 10px 12px;
  z-index: 100;
  font-family: Arial, sans-serif;
  font-size: 12px;
}

.question-help-header {
  font-weight: bold;
  margin-bottom: 6px;
  color: #1c2753;
}

.question-help-body {
  margin-bottom: 8px;
  line-height: 1.4;
}

/* "close" link-style button */
.question-help-close {
  background: none;
  border: none;
  padding: 0;
  font-size: 12px;
  color: #0000ee;
  cursor: pointer;
  text-decoration: underline;
}
</style>

<script>
whenEvent('render:finish', function () {
  if ((this_tree_id == "767916476" || this_tree_id == "767916476000") && this_node_id == '1') {
    var ids = [
      { id: '#productMainSelect', sessId: 'product_id', sessName: 'product_name', sessProv: 'product_provider_id' },
      { id: '#productOneSelect',  sessId: 'product_one_id', sessName: 'product_one_name', sessProv: 'product_one_provider_id' },
      { id: '#productTwoSelect',  sessId: 'product_two_id', sessName: 'product_two_name', sessProv: 'product_two_provider_id' }
    ];

    ids.forEach(function (cfg) {
      var $el = $(cfg.id);
      if ($el.length === 0) return;

      // Optional enhancement via Select2 (if available)
      if (typeof $.fn.select2 === 'function') {
        $el.select2({
          width: '100%',
          placeholder: '-- Select a product --',
          allowClear: true
        });
      }

      // Persist selection to session variables
      $el.off('change.zing').on('change.zing', function () {
        var val = this.value || '';
        var text = val ? (this.options[this.selectedIndex]?.text || '') : '';
        var providerId = val ? (this.options[this.selectedIndex]?.getAttribute('data-provider-id') || '') : '';

        assignSessionVars({
          [cfg.sessId]: val,
          [cfg.sessName]: text,
          [cfg.sessProv]: providerId
        });
      });
    });
  }
});
</script>

# claude.md - Prod - Defaqto Use Case (tree 767916476)

## Purpose
Defaqto product comparison for First Central renewals agents. Launched mid-journey from the Agent Portal (current starting tree: DPA 2.0, 591464224). Agent picks the First Central product being renewed plus 1-2 comparison products; Zingtree calls Defaqto, builds a comparison table and an AI summary.

## Architecture
- 6 Data (root): Defaqto Auth Token (CO 1160) + LoadDisplaySettings (1150) -> 7
- 7 Script: finds dropdown IDs from display settings -> 2
- 2 Data: LoadProductDropDownList x3 (1151, 1159, 1161) + GetQuestionResponses (1158) -> 3
- 3 Script: builds 3 <select class="zt-data"> dropdowns (names product_id, product_one_id, product_two_id), preselects prior choices -> 1
- 1 Content: Product Selection. Next -> 12, Skip -> 11
- 12 Script: Validate Product Selection. Sets is_product_selection_valid + product names/provider IDs -> 13
- 13 Logic: is_product_selection_valid == true -> 5, else -> 14
- 14 Content: No Selection ("No fields selected, please make a selection before proceeding.") -> 3
- 5 Data: LoadAnswersByQuestionIDs x3 (1155, 1156, 1157) -> 8
- 8 Script: comparison table + star rating HTML -> 9
- 9 AI Action 81 (AI Recommendation) -> 4
- 4 Content: Compare. Back to renewals -> 11
- 10 AI Action 82 (Ask more questions) - unlinked
- 11 Tree node: returns to the calling tree

## Data dictionary
- Form: product_id, product_one_id, product_two_id (captured natively from node 1 selects); product_name / product_one_name / product_two_name and *_provider_id (set by node 12); is_product_selection_valid (node 12)
- Transforms: productMainDropdownHtml, productOneDropdownHtml, productTwoDropdownHtml, defaqto_question_ids (node 3); dropdownIdYourProduct/ProductOne/ProductTwo (node 7); defaqtoComparisonTableHtml, defaqtoStarRatingHtml, defaqtoComparisonJson(Obj) (node 8)
- actions.*: defaqto_auth_token, defaqto_loaddisplaysettings, defaqto_loadproductdropdownlist_product(_1/_2), defaqto_getquestionresponses, defaqto_loadanswersbyquestionids(_product_1/_product_2), defaqto_compare

## Conventions & gotchas
- Never rely on tree-level script_code for data capture. When this tree runs as a subtree, the STARTING tree's script_code/CSS loads, not this one's. The old whenEvent/assignSessionVars handler only existed in 609698422; when First Central moved agents to DPA 2.0 (591464224) selections silently stopped saving and every LoadAnswers call sent productId "" (Defaqto 500).
- Styling (css/script_code) for the compare screen must also exist in the starting tree.
- LoadAnswers with an empty productId returns 500 by design - node 12/13 prevent that call.

## Changelog
- 2026-10-19 · Brent / Claude · Fix Oct 2026 "no data" issue: node 3 selects made native zt-data form fields; added node 12 (validation script), 13 (logic), 14 (No Selection screen); node 1 Next now -> 12; added this claude.md node.
